formal_role: Defines rows and columns of input-output system
systems_modeling_role: Determines which production relationships are visible
review_warning: Aggregation can hide critical dependencies bottlenecks or heterogeneous activities

formal_role: Records intersectoral flows from supplying sectors to using sectors
systems_modeling_role: Defines empirical structure of production interdependence
review_warning: Transaction values depend on data source accounting framework year valuation basis and boundary

formal_role: Normalize intersectoral flows by sector output
systems_modeling_role: Define direct input requirements per unit of output
review_warning: Coefficients assume stable production recipes over scenario

formal_role: Defines exogenous demand vector applied to production system
systems_modeling_role: Drives total output requirements through direct and indirect effects
review_warning: Scenario results depend strongly on demand definition and boundary

formal_role: Solves total requirements through inverse of net requirements
systems_modeling_role: Captures direct and indirect production requirements
review_warning: Invertibility conditioning and productivity assumptions should be reviewed

formal_role: Summarizes total requirements or extensions per unit final demand
systems_modeling_role: Supports compact reporting of system dependence
review_warning: Multipliers are estimates under assumptions not automatic causal proof

formal_role: Applies emissions energy water material labor or other coefficients to output requirements
systems_modeling_role: Connects final demand to indirect environmental or social impacts
review_warning: Extension coefficients require unit boundary allocation and provenance review

formal_role: Defines how assumptions uncertainty sensitivity and limitations are documented
systems_modeling_role: Prevents sector dependency estimates from being overstated
review_warning: Input-output models should support structured interpretation not replace domain judgment
